paragraphs.text:
“Professor!”  She  rushes  to  your  arms.  Even  Norman,  not 
known for demonstrative gestures, rises to embrace her. Sylvia 
is haggard from the physical and psychological ordeal of her 
abduction but has proven tough enough to survive. She explains 
that she has been fed by the sasquatches and not harmed. For 
a time, she was not allowed to leave the rock overhang, but by 
showing kindness and consideration to the young sasquatches, 
she  was  permitted  to  roam  around  the  vague  limits  of  the 
encampment. She thinks that it would be possible to escape, 
but before you came, she feared to be alone in the lost valley 
and the Big Woods around it.
The three of you plot your escape.
Make an INT roll: if you succeed, go to 387; if you fail go to 389.
